description: Agent IP Records: submit license records with the register records they answer to: the moment the records are read at; the licensor with its reference and name; each license with its id, reference, licensor, licensee, the registration or patent numbers it grants, the moment its recorded term ends, whether it is listed active or ended and whether it allows sublicensing; each register record with its id, number, title and the owner the register records; each royalty record with its id, reference, the license, the numbers it is recorded for, the amount and the currency; each sublicense with its id, reference, the license it rests on, the sublicensee and the numbers it grants. The signed report gives the licensor and the licenses, each licensed mark or patent against the owner the register records, each license listed active against its recorded term, each royalty record against the assets its license grants, and each sublicense against a license on file that allows it, and counts them, and names divergent license records: a license recorded for a mark or patent the licensor’s records do not show it owning, a license whose recorded term has passed while it is still listed active, a royalty record that does not match the licensed assets, and a sublicense asserted with no license on file that allows it; then a royalty naming a license the records do not hold and a sublicense reaching assets its license does not grant, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No licenses, no register records beside the licenses, or an active license with a term end and no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Licenses, register records, royalties and sublicenses match by letters and digits, licensors and owners compare without case, punctuation or company endings, a license with no licensor of its own reads under the stated licensor, a licensed mark or patent counts as owned only when the register records the licensor as its owner, and terms compare by the day. This reads whether each license rests on title the register shows and stays inside its own grant. Verdict ip_license_divergent, ip_license_partial, ip_license_unverified or ip_license_consistent. POST /api/ip-license-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
